methods.name: getprotocolparams
methods.description: Returns protocol timing and fee parameters for the current network.

response.name: registerDeadline
response.description: Blocks after reveal end before unregistered names expire.

response.name: renewalWindow
response.description: Blocks before a registered name expires without renewal.

response.name: renewalMaturity
response.description: Blocks after registration before first renewal is needed.

response.name: transferLockup
response.description: Blocks before a transfer can be finalized.

response.name: auctionMaturity
response.description: Blocks after revoke before name can be re-auctioned.

response.name: coinbaseMaturity
response.description: Confirmations before coinbase output is spendable.

response.name: renewalFeePercent
response.description: Percentage of registration value charged as renewal fee.
